material_news_signals.body_text: following the scoring splurge in week 1 defenses struck back on sunday the 13 afternoon games on sunday averaged 36 8 points boosted by the two prime time contests the in recent memory and that s without the no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza at the helm yet the bengals would probably rank as the next most surprising 2 0 squad not because of the record but because of how they ve won their games on the back of the defense as joe burrow got battered and the offense scuffled for much of sunday s contest in houston the defense kept giving c j stroud and the texans fits the run defense turnaround led by dexter lawrence and jonathan allen has completely flipped how the bengals can play a year ago they were getting gashed as the young linebackers struggled through being a field stretching menace k c turned back the clock on sunday night with travis kelce looking spry and gobbling up 101 yards and mahomes dropping bombs in the ot win the qb threw for 382 passing yards and three tds while playing near flawless football the presence of kenneth walker has completely unlocked the chiefs offense the rb wasn t as dynamic on sunday night as he was in week 1 yet he still bulldozed his way for 117 yards on 24 carries the threat of walker however is a massive boon to mahomes it opens up the play action in a way the two time mvp hasn t had in the past against indy he recorded a career high 14 completions on play action passes per next gen stats across 17 play action attempts he totaled 137 yards and two touchdowns also after failing to complete a downfield pass in week 1 mahomes finished with six completions on nine downfield attempts 10 air yards for 154 yards after years of living in an offensive box and having to manufacture scores the hard way while leaning on the defense the chiefs attack finally looks like it inhaled fresh oxygen vikings dominant d here to stay boy the vikings can coach the early front runners for coach of the year and assistant coach of the year should both reside in minnesota kevin o connell has made the offense work without his starting quarterback and one of his top running backs starting in place of kyler murray carson wentz struggled in the rain soaked soldier field conditions but unlike in previous years wentz avoided the catastrophic turnover that might have sunk his team the far more impressive unit however belongs to brian flores the vikings defense has been the biggest game changer in a young season the ferocious d flipped the script on green bay in week 1 then smothered a bears team that had just put up 59 points keeping ben johnson s offense out of the end zone for 60 minutes in a 9 3 win flores blitzed caleb williams on 27 of his 33 dropbacks 81 8 before he exited the game in the season he fired majestic strikes and moved with the full capability that has defined his brand in the win over the colts the fact he s operating in an offense that now has a legitimate running game is attempt against man were the second fewest in the nfl and his five ints were tied for second most brock purdy is another early mvp candidate after lighting up the rams and dolphins to start the season posting a league best completion percentage of 80 4 dak prescott got back on track in week 2 dropping an absurd amount of gorgeous dimes on ceedee lamb in a 37 20 romp over washington and reminding the football world of his elite talents yes i called him elite and i m not exaggerating matthew stafford returned to form after looking rusty in his 2026 debut torching the giants by leaning heavily on davante adams jared goff was excellent in the second half of detroit s week 2 loss a reality that will be lost on most who only check final scores for the lions sake hopefully his efforts will produce more wins going forward next gen stats insight via nfl pro goff has the most games with 2 passing touchdowns and zero interceptions in the nfl since the start of 2024 18 2023 25 2022 31 and decision making and willingness to let it rip while under duress he and the bengals haven t been consistently explosive through two weeks but burrow deserves credit for going into houston and leading cincinnati to a 14 point win next gen stats insight via nfl pro burrow completed all three of his deep passes 20 air yards to ja marr chase for 73 yards and two tds in week 2 against the texans it was jarring to watch baltimore s offense lose its juice once derrick henry disappeared from the game plan in week 2 and it didn t reflect well on lamar jackson yes he didn t have wr1 zay flowers available sparkling reputation for at least one week next gen stats insight via nfl pro jackson used play action on 34 2 of dropbacks against the saints completing 6 of his 10 play action attempts for 101 yards forward his dropoff in the second half was disappointing though and contributed directly to jacksonville s defeat tier 3 tyler shough has an obvious clutch gene and unchecked bravery that has already offense in a situation that could have taken a downward turn with a lesser quarterback next gen stats insight via nfl pro lock completed 7 of 11 downfield pass attempts 10 air yards for 175 yards in late game heroics with a j brown no longer in the mix in philly hurts rapport with devonta smith is among the most enjoyable developments of the early portion of 2026 c j stroud has played well at times in the first two weeks but he hasn t yet strung together a complete performance next gen stats insight via nfl pro through two weeks stroud leads the league in dropbacks 104 and pass attempts 93 only 10 8 of his pass attempts have been thrown at or behind the line of scrimmage the second lowest rate in the league jayden daniels played really well in the first half of washington s week 2 loss and likely would have kept the game close to the very end had he not suffered a dislocated left elbow on the final play of the second quarter it s a massively disappointing development for both the commanders and fans of electrifying quarterback play brian flores vikings defense got after caleb williams whose fast and loose playing style burned him when he attempted an off balance throw on the run that resulted in an interception williams still had his moments but he couldn t overcome the elements or minnesota s aggression and his hamstring injury was an awful way to end his day we ll all hope williams can return near full strength before long because he s so fun to watch tier 4 jordan love was thrown into the rain at metlife stadium in week 2 and unsurprisingly he struggled he did manage to lead a comeback victory with an offense that lacks any semblance of a running game though he ll need to improve before long or else he ll continue to hover around the dalton line daniel jones did his best to keep the colts in a thrilling sunday night contest and nearly threw them to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro jones used play action on 51 5 of his dropbacks vs the chiefs his second highest rate in a game in his career and was effective when doing so completing 14 of his 16 attempts for 159 yards and a touchdown his second most yards on play action passes in a game in his career kirk cousins has been tremendously fun to watch especially for fans of grizzled veterans who might be getting their final chance to play meaningful football before father time arrives cousins play against the chargers was heroic at times and he s done a great job of quieting the conversation regarding rookie fernando mendoza s eventual rise to the top job next gen stats insight via nfl pro cousins joined tom brady 2021 2015 and peyton manning 2014 as the only quarterbacks age 38 or older with at least three touchdown passes in each of his team s first two games of a season drake maye played better against the steelers than the 20 3 final score suggested but the patriots have a problem with finishing drives maye still isn t close to the elite quarterback he was in 2025 tier 5 justin herbert isn t the main reason the chargers are 0 2 he s made plenty of excellent throws but he also isn t helping los angeles in key moments when taking unnecessary risks that result in turnovers next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert has gone 0 for 7 with two ints on tight window throws this season less than one yard of separation while attempting those throws at a 13 0 clip a mark just below the nfl average 14 3 geno smith s solid start carried over into week 2 for a portion of the contest but the weather didn t help his efforts in a disappointing loss bo nix and pro nix completed 16 of 17 passes against four or fewer rushers for 205 yards and a td in week 2 against the jaguars tied for the second highest completion percentage when not facing the blitz by any quarterback since the start of last season min 10 attempts jaxson dart s encouraging start to 2026 was interrupted by a knee injury that wiped out the rest of his season throwing the giants into a depressing and familiar scenario from which they thought they d graduated tier 6 cam ward and the titans were much better offensively in week 2 they gave the eagles a four quarter battle most didn t expect to see ward appears to be gaining confidence in brian daboll s offense and has regained some of his playmaking ability that drove optimism after his rookie season although there s still plenty
